column1: - `reason` names the actual shortfall, e.g. "only 1 of 5 components have a value
(3 required)" or "only 0 of 5 components are data-derived (2 required)".
- `priority_score` is what the row would have scored. It is included so the withheld row
can be judged, not so it can be used as a ranking: the row carries no rank anywhere.
- Withholding is not a verdict about the target. It says the evidence needed to order it
